headline:
Rock-steady business,
priced like one
chart_note: 10-day range: $933.51 - $971.40, roughly flat over the window - up 1.2% today alone.
why_today: Up 1.2% today in an otherwise flat 10-day stretch - membership-driven revenue keeps growing steadily, though margins stay razor-thin as always.
pro_1: Very low beta (0.86) - one of the more defensive, predictable large-cap names to hold
pro_2: Earnings up 45.5% YoY on 21.5% revenue growth - consistent execution, not a one-quarter blip
con_1: PEG ratio of 4.5 is rich - the market is charging a real premium for that stability
con_2: Profit margin of just 3% is structurally thin - the retail membership model leaves little room for error
